stem.text: Iodine and propanone react according to the following equation.
If the concentration of propanone is increased, keeping the total reaction volume constant, the initial rate of the reaction also increases.
What could be the reason for this?

A.text: A greater proportion of collisions are successful at the higher concentration.

B.text: The particles are further apart at the higher concentration.

C.text: The particles have more energy at the higher concentration.

D.text: There are more collisions per second between particles at the higher concentration.
